profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and 3D Graphics specialist with over 25 years of experience building immersive visualizations, UI/UX frameworks, and medical robotic software
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer and 3D Graphics specialist with over 25 years of experience building immersive visualizations, UI/UX frameworks, and medical robotic software for industry leaders like Align Technology, Amazon, and Electronic Arts. Proven track record of inventing scalable architectures and driving end-to-end product lifecycles from concept to production.

• Graphics: OpenGL, OpenGL-ES, GLSL, HLSL, OpenInventor, Direct3D
• Languages: C++19 with STL, Managed C++, C#, Java, PHP, JavaScript
• Embedded: Qt/QML 5, Android, BlackBerry OS, WindowsCE
• Windows: VisualC++, VisualStudio, .NET, MFC, COM, ATL, Win32
• Android: JDK, Android Studio, Android TV Leanback Library
• Collaboration: Git, Jira, SourceSafe, Perforce, StarTeam, Subversion

positions.title: Independent Inventor & Researcher
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Researched, designed, and prototyped a novel utility solution in the LiDAR laser scanning space. Filed a formal utility patent application with the USPTO (Patent Application No. 450,691 / Patent Pending).
• Conducted comprehensive prior art searches, competitive analysis, and technical feasibility studies to validate market and design uniqueness.
• Drafted complete patent specifications, including detailed technical drawings/diagrams, claims, and background descriptions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Predictability Software
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Designed and developed treatment planning software used internally by dental technicians.
• Developed extensible infrastructure for 3D visualizations of clinical concepts.
• Collaborated with Biomechanical Engineers to prototype new teeth movement mechanisms.
• Collaborated with Operations Engineers to monitor usage and gather feedback for on-going software enhancements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Monarch Platform Team
positions.description: Developed User Experience components for Monarch Platform Robotic Endoscopy.

company.name: Auris Health, Inc., a Johnson & Johnson Company

positions.title: Software Engineer Level 5, FireTV Core Experience Team
positions.description:
• Developed user experience components and infrastructure. Adapted Android TV Leanback Library with framework for server-based configurations. Implemented Accessibility components for the visually impaired.
— JDK, Android Studio, Android TV Leanback Library

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Sims 4 Build Mode Team
positions.description:
• Developed in-game experience for building playable character’s home. 3D objects are picked from a pallette and positioned in immersive 3D environment.
— OpenGL, HLSL, C++, Visual Studio

positions.title: 3D Graphics Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed infrastructure for rendering 3D Graphics over live video for automated hair transplantation robot. Developed 3D modeling software to visualize patient’s head in treatment planning software.
— C++, OpenGL, Direct3D, C#, C++/CLI, WPF, VisualStudio

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated Stitcher service with Sonos Wireless Music System. Updated Stitcher streaming audio player for BlackBerry OS 5.0. Optimized code for audio buffering, networking, multi-threading, and user interface.
— Java, J2SE, PHP, SOAP, SAX, BlackBerry JDE 5.0

positions.title: 3D SDK Development Lead
positions.description:
• Ownership of the 3D Graphics SDK and Application Framework used by all Align applications including manufacturing control, R&D, treatment planning, and case review software called ClinCheck. Added new components including pooled resource allocation and memory management, plugins management, event queueing and dispatching, event handling and dependency, scenegraph traversal and management, and OpenGL rendering pipeline.
— C++, STL, OpenGL, VisualStudio

positions.title: 3D Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Direct3D 10 drivers. Developed OpenGL-ES drivers for ARM7 and XScale processors. Developed tool for capturing GL system calls made by games.
— C++, Direct3D, OpenGL-ES, VisualStudio

positions.title: Software Design Engineer, Client Applications Group
positions.description:
• Developed DVR and VOD components for MicrosoftTV Platform. Designed and implemented COM components for scheduling of recordings, multi-tuner conflict resolution, and searching through the Electronic Program Guide. Patented mechanism for short-term buffer management.
— C++, COM, ATL, JavaScript, HTML, VisualStudio, WindowsCE

positions.title: Software Engineer, Document Infrastructure Group
positions.description:
• Developed Object-Oriented Database for managing documents on a WindowsCE tablet. Developed transaction logging and desktop synchronization system. Documented software design and architecture for transfer of Intellectual Properties to Microsoft.
— C++, VisualC++, WindowsCE

company.name: Uppercase, Inc. - A Xerox New Enterprise Company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Jane’s Combat Simulations Group: Developed Graphical User Interface engine with custom widgets, menus, and windows.
Credit in game Jane’s WWII Fighters for Windows 98, December 1998.
— C++, Direct3D, DirectDraw, WinGDI, Visual C++

• Graphics Tools Group: Developed 3-D WorldBuilder tool for placing in-game objects and generating game data.
Credit in game Road Rash 3D for Sony Playstation, July 1998.
— C++, Open-GL, OpenInventor, Visual C++

positions.title: Games Programmer
positions.description:
Developed 3-D game engine for Windows 95 using Direct3D 3.0 API. Developed 3-D file format conversion tools. 
→ Direct3D, DirectDraw, C++, VisualC++

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst B, KR-BusinessBase Team
positions.description:
• Developed Windows 95/NT application for accessing Knight-Ridder's DIALOG online database. Developed interface with the proprietary communications API.
— C, Windows SDK

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Graphics Software Engineer: Developed utilities for graphics accelerator cards. Implemented screen adjustment features in firmware.
— C, Windows SDK

• Technical Support Representative: Resolved issues with graphics and sound cards. Developed customer-service database and application.
— FoxPro for Windows

positions.title: Customer Support Representative
positions.description:
• Helped customers use proprietary Mac and Windows messaging and collaboration software. Troubleshoot phone line modem issues. Developed database and application to track and to annotate incoming calls.
— FoxBase+/MAC
